name: Memory of the Plateau
disable: DC 36 Stealth check (master) to approach the crystal sphere followed by DC 38 Thievery check (master) to remove the sphere from the pedestal without triggering the hazard, or DC 36 Arcana check or DC 36 Occultism check (expert) twice to unweave the illusion, or Dispel Magic (8th rank; counteract DC 34)
reset: The hazard deactivates automatically after 1 minute. The hazard reactivates after 1 hour unless the crystal is removed from the pedestal.
routine:
(1 action) The hazard fills the hearts of those affected by the illusion with a longing for the surface. Each creature in the area that hasn't disbelieved the illusion attempts a DC 38 Will save save. This is an emotion and mental effect.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature is Stupefied 1 for 1 round.
Failure The creature is Stupefied 2 and Slowed 1 for 1 round.
Critical Failure The creature is Stupefied 3 and Slowed 2 for 1 round.

items.name: Illusory Vista
items.text:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet of the crystal sphere or the sphere is removed from the pedestal

---
Effect The chamber seems to fade away and is replaced by an image of the Storval Plateau at night. Each creature in the area must succeed at a DC 40 Will save save or become convinced they've been transported to Golarion's surface. A creature can disbelieve the illusion by succeeding at a Perception check to seek dc=40. The hazard then rolls initiative.

text: An illusion of the Storval Plateau fills creatures with a longing for the surface.
